title: Fix figure numbering, SVG text stretching and marker tracking
source_handoff: external review of the Edition 1 draft, findings R26-R28
acceptance_criteria: No generated asset embeds its own figure number, so Typst is the only owner of Figure N; this removes both lines from book/evidence/check-waivers.txt

The PlantUML-exported SVG text no longer renders with per-letter stretching: the textLength and lengthAdjust attributes that PlantUML emits are removed at export, recorded as a postprocess step in the figure manifest, and verified by export.sh --check
Diagram labels are readable at 100% without zoom, and no label overflows its container after the attributes are removed
The marker style's letter tracking is reduced and verified against the rendered page and the extracted text
book/build.sh fails if an asset contains a Figure number or if a registered figure is never embedded
